articles.title: This Robot Dog Just Ran a Marathon — and Beat the Average Human
articles.summary: A robot dog named RAIBO2 finished a 26.2-mile marathon in South Korea in 4 hours and 20 minutes — faster than the average human. It still had a third of its battery left!

articles.title: Wile E. Coyote Finally Gets His Day in Court — and You Can Watch It at Home
articles.summary: The Looney Tunes movie Coyote vs. Acme was almost thrown away by Warner Bros. Now you can rent or buy it at home starting September 29, 2026. It's about Wile E. Coyote suing the company that makes his broken gadgets.

articles.title: A Pelican With a Problem Knocks on the Door — Literally
articles.summary: A wild pelican pecked on a NOAA lab door in Florida — and it had a good reason. A hook was stuck in its wing and cactus spines in its foot. Scientists freed it in 10 minutes.
